body:
Static dispatch of native method calls is considered normal behavior, necessary for optimization. See the discussion in #55024. The issue only affects static custom methods whose names match non-static methods of the `GDScript` class and its ancestors (since a GDScript class is both a type and a value).

Relying on the analyzer (the `is_meta_type` flag) to address this issue may not be a good idea, as it exacerbates the already confusing behavior. We've already had several bugs related to `is_meta_type`, so I think it's a bad idea for it to affect call dispatch, i.e. if `MyClass.reload()` and (`MyClass as GDScript).reload()` compile to calls to different methods. This isn't obvious from a user perspective either (but to be fair, we already have similar behavior with `static_typed.native_method()` vs `(static_typed as Variant).native_method()`, the latter invokes a custom "override" if it exists).

Also, static methods can be called on instances, in derived classes, and can be obtained as `Callable`s. If we follow your proposed path, all these cases should be considered and tested.

Finally, this change could be considered a compatibility breaker. It's unlikely many people rely on this behavior, but there's a small chance that someone calls a method on a class without casting it to `GDScript` (or its ancestor) specifically to call a non-static class method as a resource.

Perhaps we should instead add a warning that is treated as an error by default (like `NATIVE_METHOD_OVERRIDE`) about a custom static method shadowing a non-static method of the `GDScript` class (class as a resource). Or we should use a combined approach (this one plus a warning), but we should ensure that this only affects static methods (and only implicit ones, which are not presented in the class hierarchy, but exist only in the `GDScript` class and its ancestors).

Thanks! Makes sense.

I can look into reworking this.

Looks like this is also this issue (Edit or at least the specific situation is mentioned here too):

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98665
